# Nepali application-letter builder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/nepali-letter/

Build an editable Unicode Nepali school-leave, office-leave or general-request letter from your own details and dates.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Prepare a short school leave request with a subject, reason, dates and applicant details, then proofread the result.

## Limits and checks

These are original editable templates, not official forms or legal advice. The receiving institution may require a different format, signature or supporting document.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
